text:
A low-angle view of a workstation. At top hangs a white sign reading "Synthesis Workstation" with Chinese characters above it, and a purple square tile bearing a black-and-white fiducial marker at its left end. Two black vertical posts support the sign area.

Upper right: a black rack holding about five clear tubes standing upright, each capped with an orange stopper; they appear empty. The rack sits on a grey extruded-aluminium frame with brackets.

Foreground: an aluminium profile platform with a white panel carrying another black-and-white marker, plus several bolts and knurled metal fittings along its right edge. Left of centre are a pale green translucent glass plate on a white pedestal and white plastic blocks. Background is a plain light wall.
